headline: Gangnam 3 districts in 'panic' over reversal of tax reform [Real estate tax turmoil]
summary: Residents and sellers in Seoul's Gangnam 3 districts are voicing regret after the government reversed a real estate tax reform. Some people who sold non-residential homes had trusted the government's earlier position.
why: Gangnam holds many of Seoul's high-priced homes, so changes to real estate taxes there influence housing market activity and household wealth in South Korea.
